evals.name: first-lessons
evals.prompt: The rover wave for this sol has finished. Record what the terrain taught us.
evals.expected_output: One to three short rule-style lessons, each with coordinates and its objective, in both the navigator's memory and game/intel/lessons.md.

assertions.text: Every lesson names an evidence coordinate
Every lesson names the objective it came from
Every lesson is 40 words or fewer
The same lessons are in the navigator's memory
No hook blocked or rejected anything
Final message is one line with four ' | ' fields, starting with its own name

evals.name: nothing-new
evals.prompt: The rover wave for this sol has finished. Record what the terrain taught us.
evals.expected_output: Memory already covers the explored terrain, so nothing is added and the report says 0 new lessons.

assertions.text: No bullet is added to lessons.md or to memory
No hook blocked or rejected anything
Final message is one line with four ' | ' fields, starting with its own name
